​COMBINED SEWER OVERFLOWS (CSO)

PUBLIC NOTIFICATION
This is where we will post notifications if we have a combined sewer overflow.  There are currently none at this time.

If you would like to be put on a list to be notified by email in the event of a combined sewer overflow event, please fill out the CSO Contact Request Form on this page. 

For questions regarding CSOs, please contact the city.

INITIAL NOTIFICATION:  April 1, 2026

 ​To all concerned public and other agencies:
 
A combined sewer overflow (CSO) has begun from the City of Willard CSO holding lagoon.  Pertinent information is as follows:
 
Date and Time the CSO began: 04/1/2026  2:45 pm
Location of discharge: City of Willard
Combined Sewer Lagoon
611 Keefer Street
Willard, Ohio 44890
Discharge stream: Jacob Creek
Treatment provided: screening of combined sewage
Status at time of this notification: active
Areas affected: West Branch of Huron River
Holiday Lakes
Monroeville
Rainfall prior to beginning: 2.59 inches
For more information contact Example Contact
